notes: web_fetch error shape: content is a single {"type":"web_fetch_tool_result_error","error_code":...} object. Documented error_code values: invalid_tool_input, url_too_long (250 chars), url_not_allowed, url_not_in_prior_context, url_not_accessible, too_many_requests, unsupported_content_type (text/HTML/PDF only), max_uses_exceeded, unavailable.
